calibration: Temperature scaling fitted only on validation targets; no OOS fitting.

baseline_specifications.A0_PREVIOUS_LABEL_PERSISTENCE: For each target head, carry forward the most recent label whose full information interval ended no later than the prediction observation time; abstain if unavailable.
baseline_specifications.A0_TRAIN_MAJORITY: Per root/head/horizon majority class computed from TRAIN labels only; class tie-break is lexical.
baseline_specifications.A0_TRAIN_TRANSITION_MATRIX: One-step target-state transition probabilities estimated from TRAIN only with fixed Laplace alpha=1 smoothing; condition on the most recent eligible past label, never a future-overlapping label.

manifest_hashing: SHA-256 canonical sorted compact JSON excluding manifest_sha256 field

target_spec.direction: sign(close[T+H]-close[T]); FLAT iff absolute displacement is less than one instrument tick
target_spec.future_window: strictly future closes T+1 through T+H, exactly one minute apart, within the same session and listed contract; no fill
target_spec.label_information_interval: [first close used by trailing reference, final future bar close]; future subinterval starts at T+1
target_spec.structure: efficiency=abs(log(close[T+H]/close[T]))/sum(abs(future 1m log returns)); TREND if efficiency>=0.60 and displacement>=4 ticks; RANGE if efficiency<=0.25; otherwise TRANSITION
target_spec.volatility: future RV=sqrt(mean(square(log returns))) for exactly H future 1m returns; causal reference RV is the prior 30 consecutive 1m returns ending at T; ratio <0.8 LOW, 0.8<=ratio<=1.2 NORMAL, >1.2 HIGH
target_spec.volatility_reference_window: 30 consecutive one-minute returns ending at T; same session and exact listed contract; no future observations

volatility_reference: prior 30 consecutive same-session/same-contract 1m returns; ratio thresholds <0.8/0.8-1.2/>1.2
